I'll look through the files in this folder for what the club paid for water in 2025.The files do not say what the club paid for water in 2025.

They do record the water bills for 2026, and they note that the 2025 figure was never brought to a meeting:

- On 8 September 2026, the water bill for 2026 so far was **$312.40**, “a little under last year’s pace.” Paolo did not have last year’s figure with him.
- On 3 November 2026, the water bill for 2026 came to **$486.75** in total.

Other water notes are operational only: members asking for a second tap (11 August), and the winter shut-off (6 October and 3 November). The only 2025 utility amount in the minutes is electricity for the shed lights, **$96.20**, not water.
